decision.primary_strategy: SCALE-IN BUY on confirmed support/accumulation; avoid chasing extended green candle. Increase exposure after high-volume close above confirmation level (20,000 rial).
decision.highest_risk_symbol: Any symbol with deteriorating real-money flow while price advances
decision.main_catalyst: Copper price sensitivity + volume-led expansion + risk-on regime confirmation
decision.main_risk: Copper price pullback while real-money flow deteriorates sharply
decision.entry_trigger: Price closes above 20,000 rial with expanding volume + real-money inflow persists ≥3 sessions
decision.exit_trigger: Price breaks below 18,800 rial on expanding volume + real-money outflow accelerates
decision.invalidation: Price rises while real-money flow deteriorates sharply OR sales growth rolls over for two consecutive releases OR copper price breaks down materially and remains weak
